'''Hilak''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] within the [[Rakatan Archipelago]] of the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Following the collapse of the Infinite Empire, it was mostly inhabited by barbarous tribes of [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]].
